# sendgrid_domain_authentication_validation (Resource)

Triggers DNS validation for a domain authentication. This resource validates that the DNS records for a domain authentication are correctly configured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic domain validation
resource "sendgrid_domain_authentication" "example" {
  domain             = "mycompany.com"
  subdomain          = "em"
  automatic_security = true
}

resource "sendgrid_domain_authentication_validation" "example" {
  domain_authentication_id = sendgrid_domain_authentication.example.id
}

# Domain validation on behalf of a subuser
resource "sendgrid_domain_authentication_validation" "subuser" {
  domain_authentication_id = sendgrid_domain_authentication.example.id
  sub_user_on_behalf_of    = "my-subuser"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_authentication_id` (String) Id of the domain authentication to validate.

### Optional

- `sub_user_on_behalf_of` (String) The subuser username for on-behalf-of API calls.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `valid` (Boolean) Indicates if this is a valid authenticated domain or not.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
#!/bin/bash

# Import a domain authentication validation using the domain authentication ID
terraform import sendgrid_domain_authentication_validation.example 12345
```
